sheet.transcribedBy: Claude Code (corridor/notes/geometry/anchors direct; tables 302-01/02 and 302-03/04/05 via two parallel sub-agents, each cross-checked against 619-011.json's master tables and 619-311.json's overlapping values before acceptance)
sheet.provenanceNote: Tables, notes and legend verbatim from the PDF vector text layer (PyMuPDF word extraction grouped by rounded y, sorted by x). Corridor/anchor geometry from scripts/extract_plan_geometry.py's vector output, cross-checked against a rendered crop for structural orientation only (per AUTHORING.md, layout images are for understanding structure, never for reading values). Family 2 reference sheet per Data/sheet-specs/STATUS.md -- 619-311 is Family 1's reference; this sheet shares the same corridor shape but is Freeway/Divided instead of Non-Freeway/Undivided.

speedRangeMph.note: CORRECTED after direct extraction (initial recon guessed 9 rows including 60 -- wrong). Table 302-02 genuinely has only 8 rows, skipping 60 mph entirely (25,30,35,40,45,50,55,65) -- the same gap pattern as 619-011.json's tables['011-03'] (buffer-only table), even though 619-011's own tables['011-02'] (the master taper table) DOES have a 60mph row. Verified twice: word-grouping extraction with assert_row_count, and a page-wide search for any '60' token in the table's y-band, both independently confirming no 60mph row. 302-02.note: CORRECTED after direct extraction: only 8 rows (25-55, 65 -- 60 mph is genuinely absent, same gap as 619-011.json's tables['011-03']), not 9. Lane widths 10/11/12 only. Confirmed identical to 619-011.json tables['011-02'] restricted to lateral-shift columns 10/11/12 on 7 of 8 rows, and to tables['011-03'] for the buffer column on all 8 rows -- with one genuine exception, see knownAnomalies below.

knownAnomalies.issue: CROSS-SHEET DISCREPANCY, not a transcription error: this sheet prints 800/20/21 for this cell (20 skip lines x 40 ft = 800 -- internally consistent, devices=21=skips+1). Data/sheet-specs/619-011.json's master table 011-02 prints 800/19/20 for the SAME lookup (45mph... no, same speed/lateral-shift combination) -- which 011-02's own knownAnomalies entry already flags as internally INCONSISTENT (19*40=760, not 800). Verified directly against this sheet's own PDF vector text twice before accepting -- 619-302's value is correct per the ft=skipLines*40 rule; 619-011's is the one with a printing defect. Two different official NYSDOT sheets disagree on this cell. Transcribed as printed on THIS sheet per the verbatim rule; do not silently reconcile the two sheets to match each other.
knownAnomalies.recommendation: Prefer this sheet's own value (800/20/21) when resolving 619-302; do not average or defer to 619-011's figure for this specific cell.

printed: 1. SHORT-TERM STATIONARY IS DAYTIME WORK THAT OCCUPIES A LOCATION FOR MORE THAN 1 HOUR WITHIN A SINGLE DAYLIGHT PERIOD.
2. IN URBAN CONDITIONS, ADVANCE WARNING SIGN SPACINGS MAY BE ADJUSTED IN ORDER TO ACCOMMODATE SIDE STREETS AND DRIVEWAYS. IF THERE IS A CONFLICT, MOVE THE SIGN UPSTREAM.
3. THERE SHALL BE NO WORKERS, EQUIPMENT OR OTHER VEHICLES IN THE BUFFER SPACE OR THE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE.

4. THE PROTECTIVE VEHICLE(S) SHALL MAINTAIN THE APPROPRIATE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE, BE AN UNOCCUPIED TRUCK POSITIONED PARALLEL TO TRAFFIC, PARKING BRAKE SET, PLACED IN 2ND GEAR (MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS /ENGINE OFF) OR PARK / NEUTRAL (AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS) AND HAVE THE FRONT WHEELS ALIGNED WITH THE LANE STRIPING.
5. LEFT LANE CLOSURES ARE SYMMETRICAL TO RIGHT LANE CLOSURES. SUBSTITUTE LEFT LANE CLOSED SIGN (W20-5) AND THE CORRESPONDING LANE ENDS SIGN (W4-2L).
6. CHANNELIZING DEVICES SHALL BE PLACED TRANSVERSELY A MINIMUM OF EVERY 800' AS SHOWN WHEN A PAVED SHOULDER HAVING A WIDTH OF 8' OR GREATER IS CLOSED FOR A DISTANCE GREATER THAN 800'.
7. CHANNELIZING DEVICE SPACING (CENTER TO CENTER) SHALL NOT EXCEED 40' IN THE ACTIVE WORK SPACE.
8. VEH #2 IS ONLY NEEDED WHEN THE SHOULDER WIDTH IS >= 8'.
notes.notesOrderNote: Content-identical to 4 of 619-311's 5 notes but in a DIFFERENT ORDER: this sheet's note 3 = 311's note 4 (no-occupancy rule); this sheet's note 4 = 311's note 3 (protective vehicle positioning); this sheet's note 6 = 311's note 5 (transverse devices), renumbered because two new notes (5 and 7) were inserted before it. Notes 5, 7, and 8 are new to this sheet. Do not assume note-N on one sheet means the same thing as note-N on another -- match by content.

rules.assert: G20-2 is placed on the downstream alignment, 80-400 ft past the end of the downstream taper.
